UMUTWE WA I: IBIKORWA
BY'IKORANABUHANGA
Icyiciro cya I: Ubucuruzi bukoresha
ikoranabuhanga

articles.heading: Aho ubucuruzi bukoresha ikoranabuhanga bukoreshwa 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano biharanira ko ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi
articles.text:
bw'ikoranabuhanga bikorwa mu bwisanzure ku
butaka bwabyo uretse ingeri zikurikira:
a) Gukina urusimbi, kabone nubwo rwaba
rukorwa mu buryo bw'imikino y'amahirwe na
tombola byemewe n'amategeko;
b) Ubwunganizi n'ubufasha mu by'amategeko;
c) Ibikorwa bikorwa na noteri cyangwa inzego
banganya ububasha hakurikijwe amategeko
asanzwe akurikizwa.
2. Bitabangamiye izindi nshingano z'amakuru
ziteganywa n'amategeko n'amabwiriza biriho mu
bihugu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe bisanzwe bikurikizwa mu bihugu bigize
Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe, Ibihugu
bigize Umuryango biharanira ko umuntu uwo ari
we wese ukora ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi bukoresha
ikoranabuhanga agomba guha abo ibicuruzwa na
serivisi bigenewe, uburyo bworoshye, butaziguye
kandi buhoraho bwo kubona amakuru, bukurikije
amahame rusange ku bijyanye n'amakuru
akurikira:
a) Iyo ari umuntu, utanga serivisi agomba
kugaragaza izina rye, naho iyo ari ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi, izina ryacyo, imari shingiro
yacyo, nimero yacyo mu gitabo cyandikwamo
amasosiyete cyangwa amashyirahamwe;
b) Aderesi yuzuye y'aho ikigo giherereye, aderesi
y'uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga na nomero ya
terefone;
c) Iyo umuntu arebwa n'ibikorwa byo
kwandikisha ubucuruzi cyangwa kwandikisha mu
gitabo cy'igihugu cy'ubucuruzi
n'amashyirahamwe, nimero yo kwandikisha,
imari shingiro n'icyicaro gikuru cy'isosiyete;
d) Iyo umuntu agomba kwishyura imisoro,
nomero iranga usora ;
e) Iyo ibikorwa bye bigengwa n'amategeko
ajyanye no gutanga impushya, izina na aderesi
by'ikigo cyatanze uruhushya, n'ibishingirwaho
mu gutanga uruhushya;
f) Iyo umuntu ari ugize umwuga ugengwa
n’amategeko, amategeko agenga umwuga, izina
rye ry'umwuga, Igihugu kigize umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe cyahawe ubwo
burenganzira, n'izina ry'urwego cyangwa urwego
rw'umwuga yanditswemo.
3. Umuntu uwo ari we wese cyangwa Ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi bakora ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
bukoresha ikoranabuhanga, n'iyo nta masezerano
y'ubucuruzi ahari, iyo avuga igiciro, agaragaza
igiciro mu buryo busobanutse kandi budateye
urujijoa, cyane cyane nk’igiciro gikubiyemo
imisoro, amafaranga atangwa mu kohereza
ibicuruzwa n’andi mafaranga asabwa.

articles.heading: Uburyozwe bushingiye ku masezerano bw’uwatanze ibicuruzwa na serivisi hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga
articles.text:
Ibikorwa byubucuruzi bukoresha ikoranabuhanga
bigengwa n'itegeko ry'Igihugu kiri muri aya
Masezerano umuntu ukora ibyo bikorwa
aherereyemo, hashingiwe ku ntego yagaragajwe
muri rusange n’umuntu wavuzwe ndetse
n’uwahawe ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi.

articles.heading: Kwamamaza hakoreshejwe uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga 1. Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n'ingingo ya 3,
articles.text:
igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose cyo kwamamaza,
hatitawe ku mimerere yacyo, kiboneka binyuze
muri serivisi y'itumanaho kuri murandasi,
kigomba kugaragazwa nk'igikorwa cyo
kwamamaza. Kigomba kugaragaza neza umuntu
cyangwa ikigo gikorerwa.
2. Itegeko rigenga uburyo bwo gutanga
amatangazo yo kwamamaza ndetse n'itegeko
rigenga uburyo bwo kwitabira amarushanwa
cyangwa imikino yo kwamamaza mu gihe ayo
matangazo yamamaza, amarushanwa cyangwa
imikino byatambutse mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga, bigomba gusobanurwa neza
kandi bikaboneka mu buryo bworoshye.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bibuza
kwamamaza mu buryo butaziguye binyuze mu
itumanaho iryo ari ryo ryose riziguye rikoresha,
mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, umwirondoro
w’umuntu ku giti cye utabanje kugaragaza
ukwemera kwe mbere yo kwakira iyamamaza
ritaziguye hakoreshejwe ubwo buryo.
4. Hatitawe ku biteganywa mu ngingo ya 4.2
haruguru, kwamamaza mu buryo butaziguye
hakoreshejwe ubutumwa bw'ikoranabuhanga
byemewe iyo:
a) Umwirondoro w’umuntu wakira wabonetse mu
buryo butaziguye awitangiye;
b) Uwakira yemeye ubwe ko yavugishwa
n'abafatanyabikorwa bamamaza;
c) Kwamamaza mu buryo butaziguye bireba
ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bimeze kimwe
bitangwa n'umuntu umwe cyangwa ikigo.
5. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bibuza
kohereza, hagamijwe kwamamaza mu buryo
butaziguye, ubutumwa hakoreshejwe uburyo
ubwo ari bwo bwose bw'itumanaho riziguye
rikoresha ikoranabuhanga hatagaragajwe
umwirondoro ukoreshwa w’uwohererejwe
ashobora koherezaho ubusabe bwo guhagarika
ubwo butumwa nta yandi mafaranga asabwa atari
aturuka ku kohereza ubwo busabe.
6. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byiyemeza kubuza guhisha umwirondoro
w'umuntu ugenewe gutanga amatangazo yo
kwamamaza yatanzwe hakoreshejwe serivisi
y'itumanaho ryo kuri murandasi.
Icyiciro cya II: Inshingano zituruka ku
masezerano mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga

articles.heading: Amasezerano yo mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga 1. Amakuru yasabwe hagamijwe gukora amasezerano cyangwa amakuru aboneka mu gihe
articles.text:
cyo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano ashobora
koherezwa hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga mu
gihe abakira bemeye gukoresha ubwo buryo.
Gukoresha itumanaho ry'ikoranabuhanga bifatwa
nk'ibyemewe keretse uwakira yabanje
kugaragaza ko yifuza guhitamo ubundi buryo
bwo gutumanaho.
2. Utanga serivisi cyangwa ushinzwe kohereza
ibintu, utanga ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi mu
buryo bw'umwuga akoresheje ikoranabuhanga,
ashyira ku mugaragaro cyangwa mu buryo
buziguye cyangwa butaziguye imiterere
y'amasezerano akurikizwa, mu buryo
bworohereza kubungabunga no gusubiramo
ibisabwa n’amasezerano hakurikijwe amategeko
y'igihugu.
3. Kugira ngo amasezerano akorwe mu buryo
bukwiriye, uhamagariwe gukora amasezerano
agomba kuba yarabonye uburyo bwo kugenzura
amakuru arambuye yerekeye ibyo yatumije,
by’umwihariko igiciro cyabyo, mbere yo
kwemeza ibyo yatumije no kwerekana ko
abyemeye.
4. Umuntu utanga ibicuruzwa na serivisi bye
agomba kugaragaza ko yakiriye ibyo yatumije mu
buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga kandi bidatinze.
Ibyatumijwe, iyemerwa ry'ihamagarira gukora
amasezerano no kugaragaza ko byakiriwe bifatwa
nk'ibyakiriwe igihe impande zigenewe
kohererezwa zishoboye kubibona.
5. Ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 5.3 na 5.4 y’aya
Masezerano bishobora kudakurikizwa mu
Masezerano yakozwe hagati y'ibigo by'ubucuruzi
cyangwa abanyamwuga (B2B).
6. (a) Umuntu uwo ari we wese cyangwa ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi bikora ibikorwa bivugwa
mu gika cya mbere cy'ingingo ya 2.1 y'aya
Masezerano, bigomba, kubera iyo mpamvu,
kubazwa n'uwo bagiranye amasezerano
ibyerekeye gukora neza inshingano zishingiye ku
masezerano, hatitawe ku kuba izo nshingano
zigomba gukorwa na we ubwe cyangwa n'abandi
batanga serivisi, hatitawe ku burenganzira bwe
bwo kugaragariza abo batanga serivisi ibitagenze
neza;
b) Icyakora, umuntu cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi bishobora kwikuraho inshingano
zose cyangwa igice cyazo bigaragaza ko
kutubahiriza cyangwa kudakora neza
amasezerano byaterwa n'uwo bifitanye
amasezerano uwo ari we wese cyangwa byaterwa
n'impamvu itigobotorwa.

articles.heading: Kwandika mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga 1. Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n'amategeko asanzweho mu gihugu kigize Umuryango, nta
articles.text:
muntu n'umwe ugomba guhatirwa gukora
igikorwa cy’amategeko mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga.
a) Iyo inyandiko yanditswe isabwa kugira ngo
igikorwa cy’amategeko kigire agaciro, buri
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezezerano gishyiraho
amategeko agenga ukungana kw’imikoreshereze
y'itumanaho rikoresha ikoranabuhanga
n'irikoresha impapuro, igihe amategeko y'imbere
mu gihugu asaba inyandiko kugira ngo igikorwa
cy’amategeko kigire agaciro.
b) Iyo inyandiko yo ku rupapuro isabwa
gukurikiza ibisabwa byihariye bijyanye no
gusomeka cyangwa kugaragara, inyandiko
yanditse mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga igomba
gukurikiza ibyo bisabwa.
c) Ibisabwa byo kohererezwa kopi nyinshi
z'inyandiko bifatwa nk'ibyubahirijwe mu buryo
bw'ikoranabuhanga, iyo uwakira ashobora
gukuramo inyandiko zikenewe zicapye ku
mpapuro.
2. Ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 6.2 y'aya
Masezerano ntibikurikizwa kuri ibi bikurikira:
a) Inyandiko zashyizweho umukono zerekeye
itegeko ry'umuryango n'itegeko ry’izungura; na
b) Inyandiko zihariye zashyizweho umukono
zerekeranye n’'ubwishingire bw'umuntu cyangwa
ingwate z'ibintu hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n'amategeko y'igihugu, zaba zakozwe
hakurikijwe amategeko mbonezamubano
cyangwa amategeko y'ubucuruzi, keretse iyo
zakozwe n'umuntu mu rwego rw'umwuga we.
3. Kohereza inyandiko mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bigira agaciro iyo uwakira
amaze kuyibona kandi akemeza ko yayakiriye.
4. Bitewe n'imikoreshereze yazo mu by’imisoro,
inyemezabwishyu zigomba gukorwa mu
nyandiko kugira ngo habeho gusoma neza,
ubuziranenge n'uburambe bw'ibikubiyemo.
Impamo y’umwimerere nayo igomba
kugaragazwa.
Bumwe mu buryo bushobora gushyirwa mu
bikorwa hagamijwe kuzuza intego z'imisoro
y’inyemezabwishyu no kureba ko inshingano
zayo zubahirijwe harimo gushyiraho igenzura
ry'imicungire rishyiraho inzira yizewe yo gukora
ubugenzuzi hagati y’inyemezabwishyu
n'iyoherezwa ry'ibicuruzwa cyangwa rya serivisi.
Usibye uburyo bw’igenzura bwavuzwe mu gika
cya 1, uburyo bukurikira ni urugero
rw'ikoranabuhanga bimpamo y’umwimerere
n'ubuziranenge bw'ibikubiye mu
nyemezabwishyu y’ikoranabuhanga:
a) umukono w'ikoranabuhanga wujuje ibisabwa
nk'uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 1;
b) guhanahana amakuru hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga (EDI), bisobanurwa ko ari
ukohereza mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga
amakuru y'ubucuruzi n'ay'ubuyobozi, ava kuri
mudasobwa imwe ajya ku yindi, mu buryo
bw'ubutumwa bwa EDI bwashyizweho
hakurikijwe ihame ryemewe, mu gihe
amasezerano yo guhanahana amakuru ateganya
gukoresha uburyo butuma habaho kugenzura
impamo y’umwimerere n'ubuziranenge
bw'amakuru.
5. Inyandiko yanditswe mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga yemerwa mu buryo bumwe
n’inyandiko yanditswe ku rupapuro, kandi ifite
ububasha nk’ubw’itegeko, mu gihe umuntu
wayikoze ashobora kumenyekana neza kandi ko
yakozwe kandi ikabikwa mu buryo bwizeza
ubuziranenge bwayo.
Icyiciro cya III: Umutekano w'ibikorwa
by'ikoranabuhanga

articles.heading: Gucunga umutekano w'ibikorwa byo mu buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga 1. a) Uwohereza ibicuruzwa yemerera abakiriya
articles.text:
be kwishyura hakoreshejwe uburyo
bw’ikoranabuhanga bwemewe n’Igihugu
hakurikijwe amategeko akurikizwa muri buri
gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano.
b) Uwohereza ibicuruzwa cyangwa utanga
serivisi hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga
uvuga ko yubahirije inshingano agomba
kugaragaza ko byakozwe cyangwa akagaragaza
ko iyo nshingano yubahirijwe cyangwa itakiriho.
2. Iyo amategeko y'ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano atashyizeho andi mahame, kandi nta
masezerano yubahirizwa hagati y'impande
zombi, umucamanza akemura amakimbirane
ajyanye n'ibihamya, mu buryo bwose bushoboka,
ashingira ku bimenyetso bifatika kurusha ibindi
hatitawe ku butumwa bwakoreshejwe.
3. a) Kopi cyangwa ubundi buryo ubwo ari bwo
bwose bwo gukoramo inyandiko nyinshi
z’amasezerano yashyizweho umukono
hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’ikoranabuhanga ifite
agaciro kangana n'ak'amasezerano ubwayo, iyo
kopi yemejwe nk’inyandukuro ihuje
n’umwimerere y'icyo gikorwa n'inzego zemewe
UMUTWE WA II: KURINDA AMAKURU
BWITE
Icyiciro cya I: Kurinda amakuru bwite

articles.heading: Intego y’aya Masezerano ku birebana n'amakuru bwite 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
kiyemeza gushyiraho amategeko agamije
gushimangira uburenganzira bw'ibanze
n'ubwisanzure bwa rubanda, cyane cyane kurinda
amakuru abitswe ku bikoresho, no guhana
ihungabanya iryo ari ryo ryose ryerekeye ku
buzima bwite bw'umuntu bitabangamiye
amahame agenga ihanahana ry'amakuru bwite.
2. Uburyo bwashyizweho bugomba kugaragaza
ko uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo gutunganya
amakuru bwubahiriza uburenganzira
n'ubwisanzure by'ibanze bw'abantu ku giti cyabo,
kandi bwubahiriza ububasha bw’igihugu,
uburenganzira bw'abaturage n'intego zatumye
ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi bishyirwaho.

articles.heading: Aho Amasezerano akoreshwa 1. Ibikorwa bikurikira bigomba kugengwa n'aya Masezerano
articles.text:
a) Gukusanya uko ari ko kose, gutunganya,
kohereza, kubika cyangwa gukoresha amakuru
bwite y'umuntu, Igihugu, abaturage n'ibigo bya
Leta cyangwa iby'abikorera ku giti cyabo;
b) Gutunganya uko ari ko kose amakuru mu buryo
bwikora cyangwa atari mu buryo bwikora
amakuru ari muri dosiye cyangwa agenewe kuba
muri dosiye, haseguriwe itunganywa risobanurwa
mu ngingo ya 9.2 y'aya Masezerano;
c) Ibikorwa ibyo ari byo byose byo gutunganya
amakuru bikorerwa ku butaka bw'igihugu kiri
muri aya Masezerano;
d) Gutunganya amakuru ayo ari yo yose ajyanye
n'umutekano w’abaturage, igisirikare,
ubushakashatsi, gukurikirana ibyaha cyangwa
umutekano w’Igihugu, hashingiwe ku bibujijwe
bigenwa n'ingingo zihariye z’andi mategeko
asanzweho.
2. Aya Masezerano ntagomba gukurikizwa ku:
a) Gutunganya amakuru bikozwe n'umuntu ku
giti cye mu rwego rwihariye rw'ibikorwa bye
bwite cyangwa iby'urugo rwe gusa, mu gihe gusa
ayo makuru atari ayo gutangarizwa izindi mpande
zitari muri aya Masezerano cyangwa ayo
gutangazwa;
b) Inyandukuro z’igihe gito zakozwe mu rwego
rw'ibikorwa bya tekiniki byo kohereza no
kwinjira ku muyoboro w’ikoranabuhanga
hagamijwe kubika amakuru mu buryo bwikora,
no mu buryo bw'inzibacyuho kandi hagamijwe
gusa guha abandi bahabwa serivisi uburyo bwiza
bushoboka bwo kugera ku makuru yoherejwe.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa by'ibanze mu gutunganya amakuru yerekeye abantu ku giti cyabo 1. Ibikorwa bikurikira bisonerwa ibisabwa
articles.text:
by’ibanze:
a) Gutunganya amakuru bivugwa mu ngingo ya
9.2 y'aya Masezerano;
b) Gutunganya amakuru hagamijwe gusa kubika
inyandiko yagenewe ikoreshwa bwite gusa;
c) Gutunganya amakuru bikozwe n'ishyirahamwe
cyangwa ikigo kidaharanira inyungu, ku mpamvu
z’idini, filozofiya, politiki cyangwa ihuriro
ry'abakozi, mu gihe ayo makuru ahuje n'intego
y'iryo shyirahamwe cyangwa ikigo, kandi
afitanye isano n'ababigizeayo makuru atagomba
guhishurirwa undi muntu.
2. Uretse ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 10.1, iya 10.4
n'iya 10.5 zavuzwe haruguru z’aya Masezerano,
itunganywa ry'amakuru bwite rigomba
gukorerwa imenyekanisha imbere y'inzego
zishinzwe kurinda amakuru.
3. Ku byerekeye ibyiciro bikunda gukoreshwa mu
gutunganya amakuru bwite bidakunze kubamo
kubangamira ubuzima bwite cyangwa
ubwisanzure bw'umuntu ku giti cye, urwego
rushinzwe kurinda amakuru rushobora
gushyiraho no gutangaza ibigenderwaho
hagamijwe koroshya cyangwa gusonera
inshingano yo gutangaza.
4. Ibikorwa bikurikira bigomba gukorwa nyuma
yo guhabwa uruhushya n'urwego rw’igihugu
rushinzwe kurinda amakuru:
a) Gutunganya amakuru bwite akubiyemo,
amakuru ajyanye n'imyororokere
n’ubushakashatsi mu by’ubuzima;
(b) Gutunganya amakuru bwite harimo amakuru
ajyanye n'ibyaha, guhamywa n’ibyaha cyangwa
ingamba z'umutekano;
c) Gutunganya amakuru bwite hagamijwe guhuza
dosiye nk'uko bisobanurwa mu ngingo ya 15
y'aya Masezerano, gutunganya amakuru
akubiyemo nomero y’indangamuntu y'igihugu
cyangwa ikindi cyangombwa kiranga umuntu
cyose cy'ubwoko nk’ubwo;
d) Gutunganya amakuru bwite akubiyemo
amakuru y’ibipimo ndangamiterere y’umuntu;
c) Gutunganya amakuru bwite agamije inyungu
rusange, cyane cyane impamvu z'amateka,
z'ibarurishamibare cyangwa z'ubumenyi.
5. Gutunganya amakuru bwite bikozwe mu izina
rya Guverinoma, ikigo cya Leta, abaturage, ikigo
cyigenga gikora imirimo ya Leta, bigomba
gukorwa hakurikijwe amategeko cyangwa
amabwiriza yashyizweho nyuma yo kugirwa
inama n'urwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru.
Ubwo buryo bwo gutunganya amakuru bufitanye
isano n'ibi bikurikira:
(a) Umutekano w'igihugu, kurinda cyangwa
umutekano wa rubanda;
b) Gukumira, gukora iperereza, gutahura
cyangwa gukurikirana ibyaha cyangwa gushyira
mu bikorwa ry’ibihano nshinjabyaha cyangwa
ingamba z'umutekano;
c) Ibarura ry'abaturage;
d) Amakuru bwite agaragaza mu buryo
butaziguye cyangwa buziguye ibara ry’uruhu,
ubwoko cyangwa akarere k’inkomoko, politiki,
imyizerere, ya filozofiya cyangwa imyemerere
y’idini cyangwa kuba umunyamuryango
w'ishyirahamwe ry'abakozi, cyangwa amakuru
yerekeye ubuzima cyangwa imibonano
mpuzabitsina.
6. Ubusabe bwo gutanga ibitekerezo,
imenyekanisha no gusaba uruhushya bugomba
kugaragaza:
a) Umwirondoro cyangwa aderesi y'ugenzura
amakuru cyangwa, iyo atari ku butaka bw'igihugu
kigize umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe,
umwirondoro cyangwa aderesi y'umuhagarariye
ubifitiye uburenganzira;
b) Intego yo gutunganya amakuru n’ibisobanuro
rusange by’imikoreshereze yayo;
c) Ihuza riteganyijwe cyangwa ubundi buryo
bwose bwo guhuza n'ibindi bikorwa byo
gutunganya amakuru;
d) Imitunganyirize y'amakuru bwite yakozwe,
inkomoko yayo n'icyiciro cy'abantu bagize
uruhare mu kuyatunganya;
e) Igihe cyo kubika amakuru yatunganyijwe;
f) Serivisi imwe cyangwa serivisi nyinshi
zishinzwe gutunganya amakuru, kimwe n'icyiciro
nticyongerwe hashingiwe ku cyemezo cyafashwe
n'Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe kurinda
amakuru.
8. Kumenyesha, gutangaza cyangwa gusaba
uruhushya bishobora gushyikirizwa urwego
rw'igihugu rushinzwe kurinda amakuru binyuze
mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga cyangwa mu
iposita.
9. Umuntu uwo ari we wese ku giti cye, ashobora
kwegera urwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru
cyangwa abinyujije ku munyamategeko cyangwa
undi muntu uwo ari we wese cyangwa ikigo icyo
ari cyo cyose gifite ubuzimagatozi byabiherewe
ububasha.
Icyiciro cya II: Urwego rushinzwe kurinda
amakuru bwite

articles.heading: Imimerere, imiterere n’imitunganyirize by'inzego z'igihugu zishinzwe kurinda amakuru bwite 1. a) Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
gishyiraho urwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru
bwite.
b) Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe kurinda
amakuru ni urwego rwigenga rufite inshingano zo
kugenzura ko itunganywa ry’amakuru bwite
rikorwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano.
2. Urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe kurinda
amakuru rumenyesha abantu bireba n'abashinzwe
gutunganya amakuru uburenganzira n'inshingano
byabo.
3. Bitabangamiye ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 11.6,
buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigena
ibigize urwego rw'igihugu rushinzwe kurinda
amakuru bwite.
4. Abakozi barahiye bashobora gutumirirwa
kwitabira ubutumwa bw'ubugenzuzi hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'amategeko asanzweho y'ibihugu
biri muri aya Masezerano.
5. a) Abagize Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe
kurinda amakuru bagomba kubahiriza ibanga
ry'umwuga hakurikijwe amategeko asanzweho ya
buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano.
b) Buri rwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru
rugomba gushyiraho amategeko ngengamikorere
akubiyemo, nk’ amategeko agenga imikirize
y'imanza, uburyo bwo kuzikurikirana no gutanga
ikirego.
6. Kuba umunyamuryango w'urwego rushinzwe
kurinda amakuru ntibishobora kubangikanywa no
kuba mu bagize Guverinoma, gukora imirimo
y'ubuyobozi bw'ubucuruzi no kugira imigabane
mu bigo by'ikoranabuhanga ry'amakuru
n'itumanaho.
7. a) Bitabangamiye amategeko y'igihugu,
abagize urwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru
bagira ubudahangarwa busesuye ku bitekerezo
byatanzwe mu gihe bakoraga cyangwa mu gihe
bakora inshingano zabo.
b) Abakozi b'Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe
kurinda amakuru ntibemerewe guhabwa
amabwiriza n'urundi rwego urwo ari rwo rwose
mu gihe bakora imirimo bashinzwe.
8. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byiyemeza guha Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe
kurinda amakuru abakozi mu bya tekiniki n'imari
bakenewe kugira ngo byuzuze inshingano zabyo.

articles.heading: Inshingano n'ububasha by'Inzego z'Igihugu zishinzwe kurinda amakuru 1. Urwego rw'Igihugu rushinzwe kurinda
articles.text:
amakuru ruharanira ko amakuru y’umuntu bwite
atunganywa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano mu bihugu bigize umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe.
2. Inzego z’igihugu zishinzwe kurinda amakuru
ziharanira ko Ikoranabuhanga mu
Itangazabumenyi n’Itumanaho ritabangamira
umudendezo wa rubanda n'ubuzima bwite
bw'abaturage. Kugira ngo zibigereho, zifite
inshingano zikurikira:
a) Gusubiza ubusabe bwose bwo kugira icyo
zivuga ku bijyanye no gutunganya amakuru
y’umuntu bwite;
b) Kumenyesha abantu bireba n'abashinzwe
kugenzura amakuru ibijyanye n’uburenganzira
n'inshingano byabo;
d) Mu bibazo bimwe, gutanga uburenganzira bwo
gutunganya amakuru ya dosiye, cyane cyane nka
dosiye z'ibanga;
d) Guhabwa amakuru y'ibanze ajyanye n’uburyo
bwo gutunganya amakuru y’umuntu bwite;
e) kwakira ibirego, inyandiko z'ubujurire
n'ibirego bijyanye no gutunganya amakuru
y’umuntu bwite no kumenyesha ababitanze
ibisubizo byahawe;
f) Kumenyesha byihuse inzego z'ubutabera
ibyaha bimwe na bimwe zamenye;
g) Gukora igenzura ry'amakuru yose y’umuntu
bwite, binyuze ku bakozi bayo cyangwa ku
bayobozi babirahiriye;
h) Gushyiriraho abashinzwe kugenzura amakuru
ibihano byo mu rwego rw’imiyoborere
n’iby’amafaranga;
i) Guhuza n’igihe ububiko bw’itunganya
ry’amakuru y’umuntu bwite agerwaho na
rubanda;
3. Inzego z'igihugu zishinzwe kurinda amakuru
zishobora gufata ibyemezo bikurikira:
a) Gutanga umuburo ku muntu uwo ari we wese
ushinzwe kugenzura amakuru utubahiriza
inshingano ziteganywa n’aya Masezerano;
b) Ibaruwa y'umuburo yemewe isaba guhagarika
ibyo kutubahiriza inshingano mu gihe
cyashyizweho n'urwego.
4. Iyo umugenzuzi w'amakuru atubahirije ibyo
yandikiwe mu ibaruwa yemewe imuburira,
urwego rushinzwe kurinda amakuru rushobora
gufata ibihano bikurikira nyuma yo kumva
impande zombi:
a) Gukuraho by’agateganyo uruhushya
rwatanzwe;
b) Gukuraho burundu uruhushya rwatanzwe;
c) Ibihano by’amafaranga.
5. Mu bihe byihutirwa, igihe gutunganya
cyangwa gukoresha amakuru bwite bituma
habaho kuvogera uburenganzira bw’ibanze
n'ubwisanzure, urwego rw'igihugu rushinzwe
kurinda amakuru rushobora, nyuma yo kumva
impande zombi, gufata icyemezo gikurikira:
a) Guhagarika itunganywa ry'amakuru;
b) Gufunga amwe mu makuru y’umuntu bwite
yatunganyijwe;
c) kubuza burundu cyangwa by'igihe gito
igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose kinyuranyije
n'ibiteganywa n'aya Masezerano
6. Ibihano n'ibyemezo byafashwe n'inzego
z'igihugu zishinzwe kurinda amakuru
birajuririrwa.
Icyiciro cya III: Inshingano zijyanye
n'amabwiriza agenga itunganywa ry'amakuru
y’umuntu bwite

articles.heading: Amahame shingiro agenga itunganywa ry'amakuru y’umuntu bwite Ihame rya 1: Ihame ryo kwemera ko amakuru
articles.text:
bwite atunganywa mu buryo bwemewe
n'amategeko
Gutunganya amakuru y’umuntu bwite bifatwa
nk'ibyemewe n'amategeko mu gihe nyir’ubwite
yabyemeye. Icyakora, icyo cyifuzo gishobora
gukurwaho iyo itunganywa rikenewe kugira ngo:
a) hubahirizwe inshingano zemewe n'amategeko
umukozi ushinzwe kugenzura amakuru agomba;
b) hakorwe inshingano yakozwe mu rwego
rw’inyungu rusange cyangwa mu rwego rwo
gukoresha ububasha bw'inzego bwashyizwe mu
maboko y'umugenzuzi w’amakuru cyangwa mu
rwego rw'urundi ruhande rwahishuriwe ayo
makuru;
c) Hashyirwe mu bikorwa amasezerano
nyir’ubwite arimo cyangwa mu rwego rwo gufata
ingamba ku busabe bwa nyir’ubwite, mbere yo
gukora amasezerano;
d) Harindwe inyungu z'ingenzi cyangwa
uburenganzira n'ubwisanzure by'ibanze bya
nyir’ubwite.
Ihame rya 2: Ihame ryo kuba amakuru
y’umuntu bwite atunganywa mu buryo
bwemewe n'amategeko kandi budakemangwa
Gukusanya, kwandika, gutunganya, kubika no
guhererekanya amakuru y’umuntu bwite bikorwa
mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko,
budakemangwa kandi butarimo uburiganya.
Ihame rya 3: Ihame ry'intego, akamaro
n'ububiko by'amakuru y’umuntu bwite
a) Gukusanya amakuru bikorwa ku mpamvu
zihariye, zitaziguye kandi zemewe, kandi
ntiyongere gutunganywa mu buryo bunyuranyije
n'izo ntego;
b) Gukusanya amakuru bigomba kuba binoze,
bifite akamaro kandi bidakabije ku bijyanye
n'intego yatumye akusanywa kandi
agatunganywa;
c) Amakuru ntagomba kubikwa igihe kirenze
igikenewe kijyanye n’impamvu yakusanyijwe
cyangwa yatunganyirijwe;
d) Nyuma y'igihe gikenewe, amakuru ashobora
kubikwa gusa ku mpamvu y’ibisabwa byihariye
byo gutunganya amakuru byakozwe ku mpamvu
z'amateka, ibarurishamibare cyangwa
ubushakashatsi hakurikijwe amategeko.
Ihame rya 4: Ihame ry'ukuri kw'amakuru
y’umuntu bwite
Amakuru yakusanyijwe agomba kuba ari ukuri
kandi, iyo bibaye ngombwa, akomeza guhuzwa
n’igihe. Buri cyemezo cyumvikana kigomba
gufatwa kugira ngo amakuru atari ukuri cyangwa
atuzuye, hashingiwe ku mpamvu zatumye
akusanywa cyangwa yatunganyijwe mu bundi
buryo, asibwe cyangwa ahindurwe.
Ihame rya 5: Ihame ry'umucyo w'amakuru
y’umuntu bwite
Ihame ry’umucyo risaba ko umukozi ushinzwe
kugenzura amakuru ashyira ahagaragara amakuru
bwite.
Ihame rya 6: Ihame ry'ibanga n'umutekano
by'ikorwa ry'amakuru y’umuntu bwite
a) Amakuru y’umuntu bwite agomba gukorwa mu
ibanga kandi akarindwa, by'umwihariko mu gihe
igikorwa cyo kuyatunganya gikubiyemo
kohererezanya amakuru hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga;
b) Iyo gutunganya amakuru bikorwa mu izina
ry’umugenzuzi uwo mugenzuzi ahitamo umukozi
ushinzwe gutunganya amakuru utanga icyizere
gihagije. Ni inshingano y'umugenzuzi n'ushinzwe
gutunganya amakuru ko hakurikizwa ingamba
z'umutekano zisobanuwe muri aya Masezerano.

articles.heading: Amahame yihariye yo gutunganya amakuru y'ibanga 1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza kubuza gukusanya no gutunganya
articles.text:
amakuru ayo ari yo yose agaragaza inkomoko
y’ibara ry’uruhu, y’amoko cyangwa akarere,
inkomoko y’umuntu, ibitekerezo bya politiki,
imyizerere y'idini cyangwa ya filozofiya, kuba
umunyamuryango w'ishyirahamwe ry'abakozi,
ubuzima bushingiye ku mibonano mpuzabitsina
n'amakuru ajyanye n'imyororokere cyangwa,
muri rusange, amakuru ajyanye n'ubuzima bwa
nyir’ubwite.
2. Ibibujijwe mu ngingo ya 14.1 ntibikurikizwa
ku byiciro bikurikira:
a) Gutunganya birebana n’amakuru ashyirwa
ahagaragara na nyir’ubwite;
b) Nyir’ubwite yemeye mu nyandiko, mu buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose, gutunganya amakuru kandi
hukurikizwa amategeko ariho;
c) Gutunganya amakuru ni ngombwa mu rwego
rwo kurengera inyungu z'ingenzi za nyir’ubwite
cyangwa iz'undi muntu aho nyir’ubwite
adashobora gutanga uruhushya rwe ku giti cye
cyangwa mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko;
d) Gutunganya amakuru, cyane cyane amakuru
ajyanye n’ingirabuzima fatizo, ni ngombwa
kugira ngo hagaragare, hakoreshwe cyangwa
habeho kwiregura ku burenganzira mu rukiko;
e) Gutangira kw’imiburanishirize y'imanza
cyangwa iperereza ku byaha;
f) Gutunganya amakuru y’umuntu bwite ari
ngombwa mu rwego rw’inyungu rusange, cyane
cyane ku mpamvu z'amateka, iz’ibarurishamibare
cyangwa mu rwego rw’ubumenyi;
g) Gutunganya amakuru bikenewe kugira ngo
hakorwe amasezerano areba nyir’ubwite
cyangwa kugira ngo hafatwe ingamba ku busabe
bwa nyir’ubwite mbere yo kwinjira mu
masezerano;
h) Gutunganya amakuru ari ngombwa mu rwego
rwo kubahiriza inshingano zemewe n'amategeko
cyangwa amabwiriza umugenzuzi agomba
gukurikiza;
i) Gutunganya amakuru ari ngombwa mu rwego
rwo gukora inshingano zakozwe mu nyungu
rusange cyangwa mu gukoresha ububasha
bw'ubuyobozi cyangwa zatanzwe n'urwego rwa
Leta rwashyiriweho umugenzuzi cyangwa mu
kindi gihugu cyahishuriwe amakuru;
j) Gutunganya amakuru bikorwa mu gihe
cy'ibikorwa byemewe n'amategeko by'ikigo,
kubuza ukuvogera amakuru y’ibanga no
kwangiza izina ry'umuntu.
5. Umuntu ntagomba gukurikiza icyemezo kigira
ingaruka mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko kuri
we cyangwa kimugiraho ingaruka zikomeye,
kandi gishingiye gusa ku buryo bwikora bwo
gutunganya amakuru agamije gusuzuma ibintu
bimwe na bimwe bimwerekeyeho.
6. a) Umugenzuzi w'amakuru ntagomba
koherereza amakuru y’umuntu bwite ku gihugu
kitari mu bigize Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe keretse iyo icyo gihugu cyemeje
urwego rukwiye rwo kurinda ubuzima bwite,
ubwisanzure n'uburenganzira bw’ibanze
bw'abantu amakuru yabo arimo gutunganywa
cyangwa ashobora gutunganywa.
b) Ibuzwa ryabanjirije iri ntirishobora
gukurikizwa mu gihe, mbere yo kohereza
amakuru y’umuntu bwite mu kindi gihugu,
umugenzuzi w'amakuru agomba gusaba urwego
rw'igihugu rushinzwe kurinda amakuru
uruhushya rwo kohereza ayo makuru.

articles.heading: Guhuza dosiye z'amakuru y’umuntu bwite Guhuza dosiye bivugwa mu ngingo ya 10.4 y'aya Masezerano bigomba gufasha kugera ku ntego
articles.text:
zemewe n'amategeko cyangwa zashyizweho
hakurikijwe amategeko zifitiye akamaro mu
buryo bukurikije amategeko, abagenzuzi
b'amakuru. Ibi ntibigomba gutuma habaho
ivangura cyangwa igabanyirizwa
ry'uburenganzira, ubwisanzure cyangwa
ubwishingizi bya nyir’ubwite, bigomba
kugengwa n'ingamba z'umutekano zikwiye, kandi
bigomba no gushingira ku ihame ry'akamaro
k'amakuru agomba guhuzwa.
Icyiciro cya IV: Ibirebana n’uburenganzira
bwa nyir’ubwite

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku makuru Umugenzuzi w'amakuru agomba guha amakuru akurikira umuntu ugomba gutunganyirizwa
Uburenganzira bwo kubona amakuru Umuntu uwo ari we wese ufite amakuru ye bwite agomba gutunganywa ashobora gusaba
articles.text:
umugenzuzi, mu buryo bw'ibibazo, ibi bikurikira:
a) Amakuru ashobora kumufasha gusuzuma no
kwanga itunganywa;
b) Kwemeza niba amakuru amwerekeyeho
aratunganywa cyangwa atarimo gutunganywa ;
c) Kumumenyesha amakuru bwite arimo
gutunganywa n'amakuru ayo ari yo yose ashobora
kuboneka arebana n'aho ayo makuru yaturutse;
d) Amakuru ajyanye n'intego yo gutunganya,
ibyiciro by'amakuru bwite bireba, n'abahawe
amakuru cyangwa ibyiciro by'abahawe ayo
makuru.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo guhakana Umuntu uwo ari we wese afite uburenganzira bwo kwanga, ku mpamvu zemewe n’amategeko,
articles.text:
itunganywa ry'amakuru amwerekeyeho. Afite
uburenganzira bwo kubimenyeshwa mbere y'uko
amakuru ye bwite atangarizwa ku ncuro ya mbere
izindi mpande cyangwa akoreshwa mu izina
ryabo hagamijwe kwamamaza, kandi agahabwa
mu buryo bweruye uburenganzira bwo kwanga,
ku buntu, uko guhishura amakuru cyangwa
ikoreshwa ryayo.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo gukosora cyangwa gusiba Umuntu uwo ari we wese ashobora gusaba ko umugenzuzi w'amakuru akosora, yuzuza, ahuza
articles.text:
n’igihe, ahagarika cyangwa asiba, iyo bikwiye,
amakuru ye bwite igihe ayo makuru atari ukuri,
atuzuye, abeshya cyangwa atajyanye n'igihe,
cyangwa ikusanywa, ikoreshwa, ihishurwa
cyangwa kubikwa bibujijwe.
Icyiciro cya V: Inshingano z'Umugenzuzi
w’amakuru y’umuntu bwite

articles.heading: Inshingano z'ibanga Gutunganya amakuru y’umuntu bwite bikorwa mu ibanga. Ubu buryo bwo gutunganya amakuru
articles.text:
bukorwa gusa n‘abantu bahawe ububasha
n’umugenzuzi w‘amakuru no ku mabwiriza gusa
yatanzwe n‘umugenzuzi.

articles.heading: Inshingano z'umutekano Umugenzuzi w’amakuru agomba gufata ingamba zose zikwiye, akurikije imiterere y’amakuru,
articles.text:
cyane cyane, no kugirango ayo makuru
adahindurwa cyangwa ngo asenywe, cyangwa
ngo abonwe n’izindi mpande zitabifitiye
uburenganzira.

articles.heading: Inshingano zo kubika Amakuru y’umuntu bwite ntagomba kubikwa igihe kirenze ikigenwe ku bw'impamvu zatumye
articles.text: amakuru akusanywa cyangwa atunganywa.

articles.heading: inshingano y’ubusagambe a) Umugenzuzi w'amakuru agomba gufata ingamba zose zikwiye kugira ngo amakuru
articles.text:
y’umuntu bwite yatunganyijwe ashobore
gukoreshwa hatitawe ku gikoresho cya tekiniki
cyakoreshejwe mu kuyatunganya.
b) Umukozi ushinzwe gutunganya amakuru,
by’umwihariko, akora ku buryo impinduka
z'ikoranabuhanga zitabangamira iryo koreshwa.
UMUTWE WA III: GUTEZA IMBERE
UMUTEKANO W’IBIJYANYE
N’IKORANABUHANGA NO KURWANYA
IBYAHA BIKORESHEJWE
IKORANABUHANGA
Icyiciro cya I: Ingamba z’umutekano
w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga zigomba
gufatwa ku rwego rw’igihugu

articles.heading: Urwego rw’igihugu rw’umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga 1. Politiki y'Igihugu Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyiyemeza
articles.text:
gushyiraho, ku bufatanye n'abafatanyabikorwa
bacyo, politiki y'igihugu y'umutekano
w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga igaragaza
akamaro k'ibikorwa remezo by’ingenzi ku
makuru (CH) ku gihugu, ikagaragaza ibyago
igihugu gihura na byo mu gukoresha uburyo
bwose bwo guhangana n'akaga kandi ikagaragaza
uburyo intego z'iyo politiki zigomba kugerwaho.
2. Ingamba ku rwego rw’igihugu
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byemeza
ingamba bibona ko zikwiye kandi zihagije mu
gushyira mu bikorwa politiki y'igihugu
y'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga,
cyane cyane mu bijyanye no kuvugurura no
guteza imbere amategeko, kuzamura imyumvire
no kubaka ubushobozi, ubufatanye bwa Leta
n'abikorera, n'ubufatanye mpuzamahanga,
n'ibindi. Izo ngamba zigena imikorere y’ikigo,
zigashyiraho intego n'igihe kugira ngo politiki
y'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga
ishyirwe mu bikorwa kandi zishyireho ishingiro
ryo gucunga neza ibibazo byo mu rwego
rw'umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga n'ubufatanye
mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Ingamba z'amategeko 1. Amategeko ahana ibyaha bikoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigomba
articles.text:
gufata ingamba z’amategeko na/cyangwa
z'amabwiriza kibona ko zikwiye, mu rwego rwo
gufata nk’ibyaha bikomeye ibikorwa
bibangamira ibanga, ubusugire, kuboneka no
gukomeza gukora kwa gahunda
z’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
n’itangazabumenyi, amakuru bitunganya
n'ibikorwa remezo by’ingenzi byo mu rwego
rw’ikoranabuhanga, ndetse n'ingamba zikiwiye
z’imikorere zo gushakisha no gukurikirana
abakoze ibyaha. Ibihugu biri muri aya
Masezerano bigomba kwita ku mahitamo
y'ururimi rukoreshwa mu mikorere
mpuzamahanga myiza.
2. Inzego z'Igihugu z'Ubugenzuzi
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gifata izo
ngamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa z'ubugenzuzi
kibona ari ngombwa mu rwego rwo guha
inshingano zihariye inzego, zaba izashyizweho
vuba cyangwa izari zisanzweho, n'abayobozi
bashyizweho b'izo nzego, hagamijwe kubaha
ububasha n'ubushobozi bwemewe n'amategeko
bwo gukora mu nzego zose z'ikoreshwa
ry'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga,
harimo ariko bitagarukira gusa ku guhangana
n’ibibazo by’umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga, no
guhuza no gufatanya mu rwego rw'ubutabera
busubiza ibintu mu buryo, iperereza
ry'ibimenyetso bya gihanga, ikurikiranacyaha
n'ibindi.
3. Uburenganzira bw'abaturage
Mu gushyiraho ingamba z'amategeko mu rwego
rw'umutekano w'ikoranabuhanga no gushyiraho
uburyo bwo kuzishyira mu bikorwa, buri gihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano gikora ku buryo izo
ngamba zafashwe zitazabangamira uburenganzira
bw'abaturage buteganywa n'Itegeko Nshinga
ry'igihugu n'amategeko y'imbere mu gihugu,
kandi ko burindwa n'amasezerano
mpuzamahanga, cyane cyane Amasezerano
Nyafurika yerekeye Uburenganzira bwa Muntu
n'ubw'Abaturage, n'ubundi burenganzira
bw'ibanze nk'ubwisanzure bwo kuvuga icyo
umuntu atekereza, uburenganzira bwo kugira
ubuzima bwite n'uburenganzira bwo kuburana mu
buryo buboneye, n'ibindi.
4. Kurinda ibikorwa remezo byakwibasirwa
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gifata
ingamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa z'amabwiriza
kibona ko ari ngombwa kugira ngo cyerekane
inzego zifatwa nk'iz’ingenzi ku mutekano
w'igihugu n'imibereho myiza y'ubukungu, hamwe
na gahunda z’ikoranabuhanga mu
itangazabumenyi n’itumanaho zigenewe gukora
muri izo nzego nk'ibice by’ibikorwa remezo
by'amakuru by'ingenzi; kandi ku bw’ibyo,
bigateganya ibihano biremereye ku byaha
bikorerwa kuri gahunda z'ikoranabuhanga mu
itangazabumenyi n’itumanaho muri izo nzego,
ndetse n'ingamba zo kunoza ubugenzuzi,
umutekano n'imiyoborere.

articles.heading: Gahunda y’igihugu y’umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga 1. Umuco w'umutekano w’ibijyanye
articles.text:
n’ikoranabuhanga
a) Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
cyiyemeza guteza imbere umuco w'umutekano
mu by’ikoranabuhanga mu mpande zose bireba,
cyane cyane, Leta, ibigo by’ubucuruzi na sosiyete
sivile, bikora, bifite, biyobora, bituma hakorwa
kandi bikoresha gahunda z'amakuru n'imiyoboro.
Umuco w'umutekano mu bijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga ugomba gushyira imbaraga ku
mutekano mu iterambere ry'imikorere
n'imiyoboro y'amakuru, no ku kwemera uburyo
bushya bwo gutekereza no kwitwararika mu gihe
bakoresha gahunda y'amakuru no mu gihe
cy’itumanaho cyangwa ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi
mu miyoboro.
b) Mu rwego rwo guteza imbere umuco
w'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga,
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bishobora
gufata ingamba zikurikira: gushyiraho
igenamigambi ry'umutekano w’ibijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga kuri gahunda icungwa na Leta
zabyo; gushyiraho no gushyira mu bikorwa
gahunda n'ingamba zo gukangurira ibijyanye
n’umutekano wa za gahunda n'abakoresha
imiyoboro; gushishikariza iterambere ry'umuco
w'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga mu
bigo by'ubucuruzi; guteza imbere uruhare rwa
sosiyete sivile; gutangiza gahunda yumvikana
kandi irambuye y’ubukangurambaga ku
bakoresha interineti, ibigo bito by’ubucuruzi,
amashuri n'abana.
2. Uruhare rwa za guverinoma
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano cyihatira
gushyiraho ubuyobozi mu iterambere ry'umuco
w'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga ku
butaka bwacyo. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya
Masezerano byihatira gukangurira abaturage,
gutanga inyigisho n'amahugurwa no
gukwirakwiza amakuru mu baturage.
3. Ubufatanye hagati ya Leta n'abikorera
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigira
ubufatanye hagati ya Leta n'abikorera nk'uburyo
bwo gushishikariza inganda, sosiyete sivile
n'amashuri guteza imbere no kunoza umuco
w'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga.
4. Uburezi n’amahugurwa
Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano kigomba
gushyiraho ingamba zigamije guteza imbere
kubaka ubushobozi hagamijwe gutanga
amahugurwa ku nzego zose z'umutekano
w'ikoranabuhanga ku bagenerwabikorwa
batandukanye, no gushyiraho amahame agenga
abikorera. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
guteza imbere uburezi mu by'ikoranabuhanga ku
banyamwuga mu ikoranabuhanga n’itumanaho
mu itangazabumenyi, mu nzego za Leta no hanze
yazo, binyuze mu gutanga impamyabumenyi no
gushyiraho amahame agenga umwuga; gushyira
mu byiciro impamyabumenyi z'umwuga, ndetse
no guteza imbere no gukwirakwiza ibikoresho
by'uburezi hashingiwe ku bikenewe.

articles.heading: Inzego z'igihugu zishinzwe kugenzura umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga 1. Ubuyobozi bw'umutekano w’ibijyanye
articles.text:
n‘ikoranabuhanga
a) Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano
gishyiraho ingamba zikenewe zo gushyiraho
uburyo bukwiye bw'inzego zishinzwe
imiyoborere y’umutekano w’ibijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga;
b) Ingamba zafashwe hakurikijwe ibivugwa mu
gika cya 1 cy'iyi ngingo zigena imiyoborere
myiza n'ubwitange mu nzego zitandukanye
z'umutekano w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga
n'amatsinda y'umwuga abifitiye ububasha
by'Igihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano. Ku
bw’ibyo, ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba gufata ingamba zikurikira:
i) Gushyiraho inshingano zisobanutse mu
bijyanye n’umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga ku
nzego zose za Leta binyuze mu kugaragaza
akamaro n’inshingano mu buryo bwuzuye;
ii) Kugaragaza neza, ku mugaragaro no mu
mucyo ko byiyemeje kubungabunga umutekano
w’ibijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga;
iii) Gushishikariza abikorera no kubasaba kugira
uruhare mu bikorwa bya Leta bigamije guteza
imbere umutekano w'ikoranabuhanga.
bikubahiriza ihame ryo kuryozwa ibyaha mu
bihugu bibiri.
2. Ubufatanye mu by'amategeko
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bidafite
amasezerano y’ubufatanye mu bijyanye n’ibyaha
bikoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga bigomba
kwiyemeza gushishikariza gushyira umukono ku
masezerano y’ubufatanye mu by'amategeko mu
buryo bushingira ku ihame ry'ibyaha bihanwa mu
bihugu bibiri, mu gihe byimakaza guhanahana
amakuru ndetse no gusangira amakuru mu buryo
bunoze hagati y'imiryango y'ibihugu bihuriye
kuri aya Masezerano ku mpamvu z’umubano
w’ibihugu 2 n’uw’ibihugu byinshi.
3. Guhanahana amakuru
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishishikariza ishyirwaho ry'inzego zihanahana
amakuru ku bikangisho by’ikoranabuhanga no
gusuzuma ibyago byateza, nk'itsinda rishinzwe
guhangana n'ibibazo by'ikoranabuhanga (CERT)
cyangwa itsinda rishinzwe guhangana n'ibibazo
by'umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga (CSIRT).
4. Uburyo bw'ubufatanye
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bikoresha
uburyo busanzweho mu bufatanye
mpuzamahanga hagamijwe guhangana
n'ibikangisho by'ikoranabuhanga, guteza imbere
umutekano w'ikoranabuhanga no gushishikariza
ibiganiro hagati y’abo bireba. Ubu buryo
bushobora kuba ubwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga
cyangwa rw'akarere, cyangwa bushingiye ku
bufatanye bwa Leta n'ubw’abikorera
Icyiciro cya II: Ingingo zihana

articles.heading: Ibyaha byihariye by’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n'itangazabumenyi 1. Ibitero ku miyoboro ya mudasobwa
articles.text:
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba zikenewe z’amategeko no/cyangwa
z’amabwiriza kugira ngo cyibe icyaha:
a) Kubona cyangwa kugerageza kugera mu buryo
butemewe ku gice cyangwa ku miyoboro ya
mudasobwa yose, cyangwa kurenza
uburenganzira bwo kubona;
b) kubona cyangwa kugerageza kugera ku buryo
butemewe mu gice cyangwa muri sisiteme ya
mudasobwa yose cyangwa kurenza
uburenganzira bwo kubona hagamijwe gukora
ikindi cyaha cyangwa korohereza ikorwa
ry'icyaha nk'icyo;
c) Kugumana cyangwa kugerageza kugumana mu
buryo bw’uburiganya igice cyangwa sisiteme ya
mudasobwa yose;
d) Kubuza, kugoreka cyangwa kugerageza
kubuza cyangwa kugoreka imikorere ya sisiteme
ya mudasobwa;
e) Kwinjiza cyangwa kugerageza kwinjiza
amakuru mu buryo bunyuranyije n'amategeko
muri sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
f) Kwangiza cyangwa kugerageza kwangiza,
gusiba cyangwa kugerageza gusiba, kwangiza
cyangwa kugerageza kwangiza, gusubiramo
cyangwa kugerageza gusubiramo, guhindura
cyangwa kugerageza guhindura amakuru ya
mudasobwa hakoreshejwe uburiganya. Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byiyemeza kandi
gukomeza:
g) Gushyiraho amategeko ategeka abacuruza
ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
n’itangazabumenyi kugira igenzura ku bicuruzwa
byabo ry’ibipimo by’inenge n'ubuziranenge
bw’umutekano kandi rikorwa n'impuguke
n'abashakashatsi bigenga, no kugaragariza
abakiriya inenge izo ari zo zose zabonetse
n'ibisubizo byatanzwe kugira ngo zikosorwe;
h) Gufata ingamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa
z’amabwiriza kugira ngo byitwe icyaha gukora,
nta burenganzira, bwo gukora, kugurisha,
gutumiza, gutunganya, gukwirakwiza, gutanga,
kureka cyangwa gushyira ibikoresho bya
mudasobwa ahagaragara, porogaramu, cyangwa
igikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose cyangwa amakuru
byagenewe cyangwa byakoreshejwe mu gukora
ibyaha, cyangwa kubona cyangwa gukora ijambo
ry'ibanga, imibare ikoreshwa mu kubona
cyangwa andi makuru nk’ayo ya mudasobwa
atuma umuntu ashobora kugera kuri sisitemu ya
mudasobwa igice cyangwa yose.
2. Igitero ku makuru y’ikoranabuhanga
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba zikenewe z'amategeko na/cyangwa
z’amabwiriza kugira ngo bibe icyaha:
a) Guhagarika cyangwa kugerageza gufata, mu
buryo butemewe n’amategeko, amakuru
y’ikoranabuhanga hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa
tekiniki mu gihe cyo kohereza amakuru mu buryo
butari ubwa rusange, avuye cyangwa ari muri
sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
b) Kwinjiza, guhindura, gusiba cyangwa gusenya
amakuru ya mudasobwa ku bushake, bigatuma
amakuru atari yo afatwa cyangwa akoreshwa mu
rwego rw'amategeko nk'aho ari ay'ukuri, hatitawe
ku kuba ayo makuru asomwa cyangwa adasomwa
mu buryo butaziguye kandi bwumvikana. Igihugu
kiri muri `aya Masezerano gishobora gusaba ko
hagaragazwa umugambi wo kuriganya, cyangwa
umugambi nk'uwo w'ubuhemu, mbere yo
kuryozwa icyaha;
c) Gukoresha nkana amakuru yakuwe mu buryo
bw'uburiganya muri sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
d) Gukoresha uburiganya mu gushaka inyungu
kuri we cyangwa ku wundi muntu binyuze mu
kwinjiza, guhindura, gusiba cyangwa guhagarika
amakuru ya mudasobwa cyangwa ubundi buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo kubangamira imikorere
ya sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
c) Ndetse no kubera uburangare, gutunganya
cyangwa gutunganya amakuru y’umuntu bwite
hadakurikijwe amabwiriza y'ibanze yo
gutunganya amakuru;
f) Kugira uruhare mu ishyirahamwe ryashinzwe
cyangwa mu masezerano yashyizweho
hagamijwe gutegura cyangwa gukora kimwe
cyangwa byinshi mu byaha biteganywa n'aya
Masezerano.
3. Ibyaha bifitanye isano n’ibikubiye mu
makuru
1. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba zikenewe mu rwego
rw'amategeko no/cyangwa mu rwego
rw'amabwiriza kugira ngo bibe icyaha gihanwa
n'amategeko:
a) Gukora, kwandika, gutanga, kugaragaza
gukwirakwiza no kohereza amashusho cyangwa
igishushanyo cy’urukozasoni cy’abana binyuze
muri sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
b) Kwigurira ubwe cyangwa kugurira undi
muntu, gutumiza cyangwa gutumiriza, gutumiza,
cyangwa gutumiriza, kohereza cyangwa
koherereza mu mahanga igishushanyo
cy’urukozasoni cy’abana binyuze muri sisiteme
ya mudasobwa;
c) Gutunga amashusho cyangwa ibishushanyo
by'urukozasoni by’abana muri sisiteme ya
mudasobwa cyangwa mu bubiko bw'amakuru ya
mudasobwa;
d) Korohereza cyangwa guha umwana
uburenganzira bwo kubona amashusho,
inyandiko, amajwi cyangwa amashusho
y'urukozasoni;
e) Kurema, gukurura muri mudasobwa,
gukwirakwiza cyangwa kugaragaza mu buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose bw’inyandiko, ubutumwa,
amafoto, ibishushanyo cyangwa ubundi buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo kwerekana ibitekerezo
cyangwa ingengabitekerezo y'ivanguramoko
cyangwa kwanga abanyamahanga binyuze muri
sisiteme ya mudasobwa;
f) Gukangisha, binyuze muri sisiteme ya
mudasobwa, gukorera icyaha umuntu kubera ko
ari uwo mu itsinda ryihariye ku bwoko, ibara
ry'uruhu, inkomoko, inkomoko y’igihugu
cyangwa y’ubwoko cyangwa y’idini iyo ubwo
bunyamuryango ari urwitwazo kuri kimwe muri
ibi bintu, cyangwa ku itsinda ry'abantu bihariye
kuri kimwe muri ibyo bibaranga;
g) Gutuka, binyuze muri sisiteme ya mudasobwa,
abantu ku mpamvu z'uko bari mu itsinda
ry'abantu ryihariye ku bwoko, ibara ry'uruhu,
inkomoko, inkomoko y’igihugu cyangwa
y’ubwoko, cyangwa ibitekerezo by’idini
cyangwa bya politiki, iyo bikoreshejwe
nk'urwitwazo kuri kimwe muri ibi bintu, cyangwa
ku itsinda ry'abantu bihariye kuri kimwe muri
ibyo bibaranga;
h) Guhakana nkana, kwemeza cyangwa guha
ishingiro ibikorwa bya jenoside cyangwa ibyaha
byibasira inyokomuntu hifashishijwe sisiteme ya
mudasobwa.
2. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba zikwiye z’amategeko
na/cyangwa z'amabwiriza kugira ngo zishyire
ibyaha biteganywa n'aya Masezerano mu byaha
bihanwa n’amategeko. Iyo ibyo byaha bikozwe
hifashishijwe umutwe w’abagizi ba nabi,
bihanishwa igihano gihanitse cyagenwe kuri icyo
cyaha.
3. Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa
z'amabwiriza zikenewe kugira ngo, mu gihe
umuntu ahamwe n'icyaha, inkiko z'igihugu
zitange icyemezo cyo gufatira ibikoresho,
porogaramu ya mudasobwa, n'ibindi bikoresho
byose cyangwa amakuru by'umuntu wahamwe
n'icyaha kandi byakoreshejwe mu gukora kimwe
mu byaha bivugwa muri aya Masezerano.
4. Ibyaha bijyanye n'ingamba z'umutekano
w'ubutumwa bw’ikoranabuhanga, ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba gufata
ingamba zikenewe z’amategeko na/cyangwa
z’amabwiriza kugira ngo ibimenyetso
koranbuhanga mu manza mpanabyaha byemerwe
mu rwego rwo kugaragaza vuba
ibyaha hakurikijwe amategeko mpanabyaha
y'igihugu, mu gihe ibyo bimenyetso byatanzwe
mu gihe cy'imanza kandi bikagaragazwa imbere
y'umucamanza, ko uwo bikomokaho ashobora
kumenyekana uko bikwiye, kandi ko byakozwe
kandi bigakomeza kubikwa mu buryo bushobora
gusigasira ubuziranenge bwabyo.

articles.heading: Gushyira ibyaha bimwe na bimwe mu ikoranabuhanga ry'itumanaho n’itangazabumenyi 1. Ibyaha byibasira umutungo
articles.text:
a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa z’amabwiriza
kugira ngo bihane icyaha cyo kuvogera umutungo
nk'ubujura, kwihesha ikintu cy’undi
hakoreshejwe uburiganya, gukoresha umutungo
wibwe, gukoresha nabi ububasha, gukangisha
kwambura umutungo no gukangisha kugaragaza
amakuru ya mudasobwa;
b) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba gufata ingamba zikenewe z'amategeko
na/cyangwa z'amabwiriza zikenewe kugira ngo
bifate nk’impamvu nkomezacyaha nko gukoresha
ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho
n’itangazabumenyi mu gukora ibyaha by'ubujura,
kwihesha ikintu cy’undi hakoreshejwe
uburiganya, gukoresha umutungo wibwe,
gukoresha nabi ububasha, gukangisha kwambura
umutungo, iterabwoba n’iyezandonke;
c) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba z'amategeko na/cyangwa
z'amabwiriza zikenewe kugira ngo "binyuze mu
itumanaho ry’ikoranabuhanga" nka interineti mu
kwerekana uburyo bwo gukwirakwiza mu
ruhame buteganywa n'amategeko ahana y'ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano;
d) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba za ngombwa z’amategeko ahana kugira
ngo bibuze uburyo bwo kugera ku
ikoranabuhanga ririnzwe ryashyizwe mu byiciro
by'ibikorwa remezo bishobora kwibasirwa mu
rwego rw'umutekano w’igihugu kubera amakuru
yakwibasirwa y'umutekano w'igihugu abirimo.
2. Uburyozwacyaha bw’ibigo bifite
ubuzimagatozi
Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba zikenewe z'amategeko
hagamijwe ko ibigo bifite ubuzimagatozi bitari
ibya Leta, imiryango y’abaturage n'inzego za Leta
bishobora kuryozwa ibyaha biteganywa n'aya
Masezerano, byakozwe mu izina ryabyo n'inzego
zabyo cyangwa ababihagarariye. Uburyozwe
bw'ibigo bifite ubuzimagatozi ntibukuraho
ubw'abantu ku giti cyabo bakoze cyangwa babaye
ibyitso mu byaha nk'ibyo.

articles.heading: Gushyiraho ibihano bimwe na bimwe mu bijyanye n’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho n’isakazabumenyi
articles.text:
1. Ibihano biteganywa n'amategeko ahana
a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba za ngombwa z’amategeko zigamije
kureba ko ibyaha biteganywa n'aya Masezerano
bihanishwa ibihano bikwiye, bijyanye n’icyaha
cyakozwe kandi bigatuma habaho kwikosora;
b) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba zikenewe mu rwego rw'amategeko
kugira ngo ibyaha biteganywa n'aya Masezerano
bihanishwe ibihano bikwiye hakurikijwe
amategeko yabyo;
c) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bigomba
gufata ingamba z'amategeko hagamijwe ko ikigo
kiryozwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’aya
Masezerano gihanishwa ibihano bikwiye,
bijyanye n’icyaha cyakozwe kandi bigatuma
habaho kwikosora harimo n’ihazabu.
2. Ibindi bihano bijyanye n’ibyaha
a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba z'amategeko kugira ngo hizerwe ko mu
gihe cy’ihamwa ry’icyaha cyakozwe
hifashishijwe igikoresho cy’ikoranabuhanga mu
itumanaho, urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
rushobora gutanga ibihano by’inyongera;
b) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba gufata ingamba z'amategeko zikenewe
kugira ngo habeho gukurikirana icyaha cyakozwe
binyuze mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga mu
itumanaho, umucamanza ashobora kandi
gutegeka ko inyandiko igaragaza ingingo
z’ingenzi z’icyemezo cy’urukiko, gitangazwa ku
kiguzi cy'uwahamwe n'icyaha, hakoreshejwe
ubwo buryo kandi hakurikijwe uburyo
busobanurwa mu mategeko y'ibihugu bigize
Umuryango;
c) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba z’amategeko zikenewe mu rwego rwo
gukora ku buryo kumena ibanga ry'amakuru
abitswe muri sisiteme ya mudasobwa bihanishwa
ibihano bimwe n'ibikurikizwa mu kumena ibanga
ry'akazi.
3. Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize
a) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba z'amategeko zikwiye kugira ngo hizerwe
ko aho amakuru abitswe muri sisiteme ya
mudasobwa cyangwa mu gikoresho gituma
habaho kubika amakuru ku butaka bw’ igihugu
kiri muri aya Masezerano, afite akamaro mu
kugaragaza ukuri, urukiko rushobora gukora
ubushakashatsi kugira ngo rubashe kugera kuri
sisiteme ya mudasobwa yose cyangwa igice
cyayo binyuze mu yindi sisiteme ya mudasobwa,
aho ayo makuru ashobora kuboneka cyangwa
aboneka kuri sisiteme ya mbere;
b) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bigomba gufata ingamba z'amategeko kugira ngo
hizerwe ko iyo inzego z'ubutabera zishinzwe
iperereza zibonye amakuru abitswe muri sisiteme
ya mudasobwa afite akamaro mu kugaragaza
ukuri, ariko gufatira igikoresho ariho bisa
n'ibidakwiye, ayo makuru yose kimwe n'akenewe
kugira ngo yumvikane, agomba kwandukurwa
mu gikoresho gikoreshwa nk’ubibiko bwa
mudasobwa bushobora gufatirwa no gushyirwaho
ikimenyetso kibuza gufungura, hakurikijwe
e) Ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano bifata
ingamba z'amategeko zikenewe kugira ngo aho
bikenewe kubera amakuru, umucamanza
w'iperereza ashobore gukoresha uburyo bukwiye
bwa tekiniki mu gukusanya cyangwa kwandika
mu gihe nyacyo, amakuru ajyanye n'ibikubiye mu
itumanaho ryihariye ku butaka bwacyo,
yoherejwe hifashishijwe sisiteme ya mudasobwa
cyangwa agahatira utanga serivisi, mu rwego
rw'ubushobozi bwe bwa tekinike, gukusanya no
kwandika, hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa tekinike
busanzweho ku butaka bwacyo cyangwa mu
bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano, cyangwa
gutanga inkunga n'ubufasha ku nzego zibifitiye
ububasha mu gukusanya no kwandika ayo
makuru y’ikoranabuhanga.
IGICE CYA IV: INGINGO ZISOZA

articles.heading: Ingamba zigomba gufatwa ku rwego rw'Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze Ubumwe Perezida wa Komisiyo aha raporo Inteko ijyanye
articles.text:
n’ishyirwaho n'ikurikiranwa ry'uburyo
bw’imikorere by'aya Masezerano. Uburyo bwo
kugenzura bugomba kubahiriza ibi bikurikira:
a) Guteza imbere no gushishikariza umugabane
wa Afurika gushyiraho no gushyira mu bikorwa
ingamba zo gushimangira umutekano
w'ikoranabuhanga muri serivisi z'ikoranabuhanga
no kurwanya ibyaha bikoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga n'ihungabanywa
ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu mu mikoreshereze
y’ikoranabuhanga;
b) Gukusanya inyandiko n'amakuru ku bijyanye
n'ibyifuzo by'umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga
ndetse no ku miterere n'uburemere bw'ibyaha
bikoreshejwe 'ikoranabuhanga n'ihungabanywa
ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu mu mikoreshereze
y’ikoranabuhanga;
c) Gushakisha uburyo bwo gusesengura
ibikenewe mu mutekano w'ikoranabuhanga,
imiterere n'uburemere bw'ibyaha bbikoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga n'ihungabanywa
ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu mu mikoreshereze
y’ikoranabuhanga, gukwirakwiza amakuru no
gukangurira abantu ingaruka mbi z'ibi bikorwa;
d) Gutanga inama ku bihugu bya Afurika mu
rwego rwo guteza imbere umutekano
w'ikoranabuhanga no kurwanya ibyaha
bikoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga n'ihungabanywa
ry'uburenganzira bwa muntu ku rwego
rw'igihugu;
e) Gukusanya amakuru no gusesengura
imyitwarire iganisha ku byaha y'abakoresha
imbuga z'amakuru na mudasobwa zikorera muri
Afurika, no kugeza ayo makuru ku nzego
z'igihugu zibifitiye ububasha;
f) Gushyiraho no guteza imbere ishyirwaho
ry’amategeko ngengamyitwarire agenga
imyitwarire y'abakozi ba Leta mu bijyanye
n'umutekano wo mu ikoranabuhanga;
g) Gushyiraho ubufatanye na Komisiyo
n'Urukiko Nyafurika mu bijyanye
n’Uburenganzira bwa Muntu n'ubw’abaturage,
sosiyete sivile ya Afurika, imiryango yegamiye
kuri Leta, imiryango ihuriweho na Leta
n’itegamiye kuri Leta hagamijwe koroshya
ibiganiro ku kurwanya ibyaha bikoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga n'ihohoterwa ry'uburenganzira
bwa muntu mu ikoranabuhanga;
h) Gutanga raporo ku buryo buhoraho ku Nama
Nshingwabikorwa y'Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe ku iterambere rya buri gihugu mu
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ibiteganywa n'aya
Masezerano;
(i) Gukora indi mirimo iyo ari yo yose ahabwa
n’inzego za politiki z'Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe ijyanye n'ibyaha bikoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga no guhungabanya uburenganzira
bw'abantu mu mikorere y’ikoranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Ingingo izigama Ibivugwa muri aya Masezerano ntibishobora gusobanurwa mu buryo bunyuranyije n'amahame
articles.text:
akurikizwa y'amategeko mpuzamahanga, harimo
n'umuco mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Gukemura impaka 1. Impaka izo ari zo zose zikomoka kuri aya Masezerano zikemurwa mu bwumvikane binyuze
articles.text:
mu mishyikirano itaziguye hagati y’ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano birebwa.
2. Mu gihe impaka zidashobora gukemurwa
binyuze mu mishyikirano itaziguye, Ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano byihatira
gukemura amakimbirane binyuze mu bundi buryo
bw'amahoro, harimo gukemura amakimbirane
mu mahoro, mu bwumvikane n'ubwiyunge,
cyangwa ubundi buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw'amahoro bwemeranyijweho n'ibihugu
bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano. Muri urwo rwego,
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
bishishikarizwa gukoresha uburyo n'ingamba byo
gukemura amakimbirane byashyizweho mu
rwego rw'Umuryango.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho umukono, kwemeza burundu cyangwa kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
articles.text:
Aya Masezerano yemerewe gushyirwaho
umukono, kwemezwa burundu cyangwa
kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu biyahuriyeho
n’Ibihugu bigize Umuryango hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n'Amategeko Nshinga yabyo.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa kw’aya Masezerano Aya Masezerano atangira gukurikizwa nyuma y'iminsi mirongo itatu (30) uhereye igihe
articles.text:
Perezida wa Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe yakiriye inyandiko ya cumi na
gatanu (15) yo kuyemeza burundu.

articles.heading: Ivugururwa 1. Buri gihugu kiri muri aya Masezerano gishobora gutanga ibitekerezo byo kuvugurura
articles.text:
cyangwa gusubiramo aya Masezerano;
2. Ibyifuzo byo kuyavugurura cyangwa
kuyasubiramo bishyikirizwa Perezida wa
Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe, na we akabigeza ku bihugu bigize
Umuryango mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mirongo
itatu (30) nyuma yo kubyakira;
3. Inteko y'Umuryango, ku cyifuzonama
cy’Inama Nshingwabikorwa y'Umuryango,
isuzuma ibyo byemezo mu nteko yawo ikurikira,
ari uko ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano
byose byamaze kubimenyeshwa nibura amezi
atatu (3) mbere y'uko iyo nteko itangira;
4. Inteko y’Umuryango yemeza ivugururwa
hakurikijwe amategeko ngengamikorere yayo;
5. Ivugururwa cyangwa isubirwamo ritangira
gukurikizwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu ngingo
ya 36 iri haruguru.

articles.heading: Ushinzwe kubika Amasezerano 1. Inyandiko zo kwemeza burundu cyangwa zo kwemera kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
articles.text:
aya Masezerano zishyikirizwa Perezida wa
Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe;
2. Buri gihugu kigize Umuryango gishobora
kwivana muri aya Masezerano kibimenyesha
Perezida wa Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa Afurika
Yunze Ubumwe mu nyandiko mbere y'umwaka
umwe (1);
3. Perezida wa Komisiyo y'Umuryango wa
Afurika Yunze Ubumwe amenyesha ibihugu
byose bigize Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe imikono iyo ari yo yose, kubikwa
kw’inyandiko yo kwemeza burundu cyangwa
kwemeza kuba kimwe mu bihugu bihuriye kuri
aya Masezerano, ndetse n’itangira gukurikizwa
ryayo;
4. Perezida wa Komisiyo amenyesha kandi
ibihugu bihuriye kuri aya Masezerano ibijyanye
n’ibyifuzo byo kuvugurura Amasezerano
cyangwa kuyivanamo, kimwe n’ukwifata kuri
ayo Masezerano.
5. Aya Masezerano agitangira gukurikizwa,
Perezida wa Komisiyo ayandikisha ku
Munyamabanga Mukuru w'Umuryango
w'Abibumbye, hakurikijwe ingingo ya 102
y'Amasezerano mpuzamahanga ashyiraho
Umuryango w'Abibumbye.
6. Aya Masezerano, yanditswe mu ndimi enye (4)
z'umwimerere Icyarabu, Icyongereza, Igifaransa
n'Igiporutugali, zose uko ari enye (4) zikaba
zinganya agaciro, zigomba gushyikirizwa
Perezida wa Komisiyo na we akoherereza
inyandukuro zayo zihuje n’umwimerere ibihugu
byose bigize Umuryango wa Afurika Yunze
Ubumwe mu rurimi rwemewe n'amategeko
yacyo.
